<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: AC Runtime Diagnostic
 * Description: Temporary read-only diagnostics for the Agadir Concept rebuild.
 * Version: 1.0.0
 */
if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

add_action(
	'rest_api_init',
	static function (): void {
		register_rest_route(
			'ac-runtime-diagnostic/v1',
			'/status',
			array(
				'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
				'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
				'callback'            => static function (): WP_REST_Response {
					$errors = class_exists( 'AC_WPTB_Runtime' ) ? AC_WPTB_Runtime::errors() : array();
					$encoded = array();
					foreach ( $errors as $error ) {
						$encoded[] = base64_encode( wp_json_encode( $error, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE ) ?: '' );
					}

					$data = (string) get_post_meta( 1633, '_elementor_data', true );
					return rest_ensure_response(
						array(
							'ok'                  => true,
							'php'                 => PHP_VERSION,
							'acdu_active'         => defined( 'ACDU_VERSION' ),
							'acdu_version'        => defined( 'ACDU_VERSION' ) ? ACDU_VERSION : null,
							'elementor_version'   => defined( 'ELEMENTOR_VERSION' ) ? ELEMENTOR_VERSION : null,
							'front_page_id'       => (int) get_option( 'page_on_front' ),
							'home_elementor_size' => strlen( $data ),
							'home_elementor_sha'  => hash( 'sha256', $data ),
							'runtime_count'       => count( $errors ),
							'runtime_b64'         => $encoded,
						)
					);
				},
			)
		);
	}
);
